note: CIFAR-100 test set: 10,000 images, 100 images per true class. Accuracy is correct predictions divided by images belonging to that true class, not precision. All tied worst/best classes are shown. Median column shows ranks 50 and 51 (ascending accuracy; ties ordered by canonical class ID). This is descriptive test analysis, not policy selection. No router, inference or training was run.
interpretation: These results support the motivation for input-dependent selection: despite lower overall accuracy than ResNet-101 (85.80%), ResNet-18 (79.16%) and MobileNetV3-Large (81.34%) achieve higher accuracy on forest images (71% and 76%, versus 62%); both are faster in the saved FP32 batch-32 static measurements (median 13.64 and 6.92 ms/batch, versus 131.28 ms/batch). These are descriptive results on 100 forest images, not proof of statistical significance or end-to-end routing gains.
